intro.title: Lexi's Advice
intro.subtitle: Wise words from a friend
intro.description: Hi, I'm Lexi! I'm here to share tips and guidance on school, friendships, and growing up. Sometimes the best advice comes from someone who's been there — and I've been there. Let's figure things out together.

items.title: Exam Preparation Tips
items.excerpt: As exams are almost here, Fatima wanted to share with you some ways to prepare. Be ready!
items.body:
As exams are almost here, Fatima wanted to share with you some ways to prepare. Be ready!

1. You should study well for the exam and revise before coming to school.
2. You should eat healthy food to keep your memory strong.
3. You shouldn't use your electronics such as (your iPad) for long hours.
4. To get better marks, you should sleep enough hours.
items.author: Fatima Aladsani (5C)

items.title: Stand Up Against Bullying
items.excerpt: This month, Aisha Alamri tells us how we can stand up against bullying. Stay safe!
items.body:
This month on the advice column, Aisha Alamri tells us how we can stand up against bullying! Stay safe!

Bullying is a bad habit in a person. There are a lot of people that are bullied. The bullies can also be bullied. There are different types of bullying, for example:

1. Physical bullying: when the bully hurts the other person using power. For example, one girl hitting another girl.
2. Social bullying: rolling your eyes, turning away from, or ignoring someone. Gossiping or spreading rumors about someone that results in damaging friendships.
3. Cyber bullying: this happens online. Bullies can use social media to insult or hurt someone. They may make bad and hateful comments.

If you feel like you have bullied someone, stop and apologize straight away.

Why should we be respectful?
- If I am respectful, others will respect me.
- Respect makes you a good listener.
- Respect leads to honesty.

Why is bullying bad?
- Being a bully can lead to violence.
- You might lose a friend.
- Bullies are not cool!

How to stop bullying?
- Help kids understand what bullying is and how to stand up to it safely.
- Tell kids that bullying is unacceptable.
- Make sure kids know how to get help.

Today we learnt how to respect others and that bullying is not cool. That's why we should not bully anyone no matter what they did to us. Just tell a grown-up and they will take care of the problem.
items.author: Aisha Alamri (6C)
